text: {"judgments":[{"claim_index":2,"verdict":"PARTIAL","reason":"The evidence states the figures reflect the originally approved budget and the total was adjusted to $2,600,000, but it says nothing about whether the documents break the adjustment down by category or quarter; that part is an unsupported absence assertion within a fact claim."},{"claim_index":3,"verdict":"SUPPORTED","reason":"Absence claim that only says the documents don't state how the revised budget is allocated to development across quarters; it asserts no other fact."}]}
